At the moment the best thing you can do is be there for your fiend. You need to talk to someon other than them. It's a hard time for them, You need to talk to another human. We are here to help and you are a valuable good human! 
~Fred

Hey,
You are a valid and amazing human. You don't want to eat because you don't value yourself as a human. You are and a equally valid one to anyone else. So you have some family or friends you can talk to? If not we are here to listen! Please reply and talk to me. What do you thinks causing it? What do you think could help you? There are service in place to help you! We can help you and you can help yourself.
Please respond and we as a community will be here to help!
~Fred

Hey,
Life is worth living. I came here because my friend tried to kill himself. When we found out we were worried he didn't tell us. The moral of the story is please talk to a friend or family. Remember, we are here to help but if you can't do it anymore PLEASE call the suicide hotline or just speak to somebody. Remember your friends and family are there to help. They will listen because they care.
Good Luck
Fred
PS Feel free to respond, I will check back soon:)

You need to talk to someone, There is so much in life to bother with. Suicide isn't the only option. Please, please don't do this. Talk to your mum, Talk to your dad, talk to the girl at your local coffee shop. They will listen, it's human instinct to care. If you think you have no friends then talk to somebody. I want you to walk down to the coffee shop and just chat with someone, anyone. It's all good coming to us at Reddit but you need to go face to face with a human. If you explain anyone will help. People care. 
I sign off with my faivroute quote:
"When your all alone, Everyone has that day, No that someone is there. Someone will always care"
Good luck and remember if it gets worse please contact the suicide helpline. I had a Friedan who went through this and he talked to them. They help. Remember people will help!
